Body stats
used to estimate resting burn
Open Garmin Connect → Calories → the Resting figure. Measured against you, so it beats any equation. Enter it and everything below becomes a fallback.
Calories from walking, stairs and being on your feet — the gap between a workout log and what Garmin counts. Take a rest day’s Active figure in Garmin Connect: with no session logged, that number is exactly this. Ignored on any day garmin_daily gives real steps or active calories.
The rest is only used if you leave that blank.
